props.title: Organisation overview
props.text: Review organisation accounts, invitations, runtime settings, notices and privacy request cases. Account, invitation and runtime-settings displays are read live from protected Identity and Access read models. Role grants, group membership and assignments are managed in the IAM application.

props.title: Organisation accounts
props.text: Organisation accounts are read live from protected Identity and Access data; no account directory is copied into this application. Role grants run in the IAM application, never here.

props.title: Invitations
props.text: Pending and past invitations are read live from protected Identity and Access data. Invitations carrying intended role assignments follow the governed IAM journey; this application offers no grant control.

props.title: Runtime settings
props.text: View the organisation's runtime settings. Select the settings record to edit it through the protected record save.
